svg.title: Lab
svg.desc: RiskWeft: Deterministic STRIDE-style architecture-risk scoring with a reproducible, hash-verified replay of every evaluation.; CipherLint: A Rust-first static-analysis security linter with deterministic findings, stable IDs, and SARIF export.; FlowWeft: Network-flow anomaly detection on Zeek telemetry with a deterministic baseline before any ML is introduced.; Privattice: A privilege/identity graph analyzer projecting inventory data into bounded access-path queries.; RiftRange: On-demand cyber-range orchestration: immutable lab templates, agent heartbeats, deterministic teardown.; PolicyHelix: A fail-closed OIDC + OPA + Envoy authorization gateway that rejects stale policy bundles by design.; Attestara: Sandboxed supply-chain attestation: SBOM generation and policy-gated verification inside disposable runners.; MirageMesh: A deception mesh of signed decoy sensors that spool telemetry offline and replay it once reconnected.; KeyHelix: Envelope-encryption key management with step-up reveal, KEK rewrap, and a signed, tamper-evident audit trail.; BreachAtlas: Digital-forensics case management with cryptographic evidence sealing and full chain-of-custody tracking.

g.text: Ten security-platform architectures, each with a frozen design, explicit contracts, and a recommended
build order. None has shipped code yet.
